dimension_justifications.soundness: The paired-count arithmetic, exact McNemar tests, and reported paired-SE intervals that can be checked from aggregate counts are internally consistent. However, all central outcomes remain source-reported and cannot be independently verified; the stochastic scoring estimand lacks across-seed evidence; sampling frames and preregistrations are absent; and important results are explicitly post-selected or construction-dependent.
dimension_justifications.presentation: The paper is readable, anonymous, visually intact, and unusually candid about estimand boundaries, post-selection, heterogeneous pools, and unresolved causal attribution. Evaluation is nevertheless burdened by dense decision terminology and by evidence-status inconsistencies, most notably labeling the post-selected 2L sensitivity as primary in the claim-evidence map.
dimension_justifications.contribution: The protocol-audit perspective and narrow intervention-estimand map are useful, but the empirical contribution is confined to one model, one constructed multiple-choice bed, and largely one realization of each stochastic protocol. The fixed-order result is strongly answer-position and construction dependent, limiting broader significance.

paper_summary: The paper audits five multiple-choice scoring protocols for LLaDA-8B-Instruct on constructed four-choice GSM8K pools. It reports a preregistered n=400 nominal draw-matched confidence-versus-random-mask gap of 13.0 percentage points, a post-selected 2L/2L forward-call-count sensitivity with the same gap, and a 9.0-point gap at nmc=128. On a disjoint n=819 pool, a deterministic fixed left-to-right injected schedule beats confidence ordering by 5.62 points on average, although the effect varies by distractor construction and reverses at answer position 0. The manuscript appropriately limits its conclusion to bed-local protocol non-interchangeability.
strongest_verified_contribution: The strongest verifiable contribution is the disciplined separation of nominal draw count, total forward-call count, and full-protocol estimands, together with internally consistent paired summary arithmetic. From the reported counts, the principal accuracy differences, exact McNemar p-values, and available paired-SE intervals recompute correctly. The underlying experimental measurements themselves remain cannot_verify because item-level records and analysis code are absent.
strengths: Every main comparison is paired by question, with discordant counts reported and exact McNemar testing used.
The manuscript explicitly distinguishes the preregistered matched-L endpoint from the post-selected 2L sensitivity and does not present repeated budget points as independent replications.
Multiplicity families are named for the confirmatory five-arm analysis, injected-order contrasts, chance checks, and post-hoc answer-position audit.
The intervention-estimand map correctly states that confidence versus random-mask scoring changes feedback, path, estimator, and budget jointly and cannot identify a unique mechanism.
Pool heterogeneity, the single persisted random schedule, the unpinned Python-hash defect, actual-cost limitations, and lack of cross-bed transfer are disclosed rather than hidden.
The PDF is anonymous, fits nine main-text pages before references, and has no evident clipping, overlap, or unreadable quantitative figure.
questions: Can the authors provide immutable preregistration objects and timestamps establishing the matched-L endpoint, ten-test family, power stop, fixed-order pair, and decision rules before their respective outcomes were observed?
What exact stochastic estimand is intended for mc_uniform: performance conditional on the recorded pseudorandom draws or expectation over mask-sampling randomness?
How many independent RNG seeds were evaluated for each mc_uniform budget, and does the 13-point matched-L or 2L gap persist when uncertainty over seeds is included?
What deterministic rule selected the n=400 and n=819 questions, which GSM8K split supplied them, and why do the two pools total 1219 rather than the full candidate sampling frame?
Was the fixed-order hypothesis and analysis plan frozen before any outcomes on the reused n=819 pool were inspected, including s_conf and rand_inject results?
Does the fixed-versus-confidence result persist after independently reshuffling answer positions and balancing distractor-construction strata on untouched questions?

issues.location: p. 9 Reproducibility Statement; pp. 19-20 Appendix H, Tables 22-23; evidence/repository_inventory.md; evidence/experiment_registry.json; evidence/method_provenance.tsv
issues.observed_evidence: The snapshot explicitly lacks raw per-item outputs, sampling identifiers, persisted schedules, machine-readable preregistrations, implementation code, environment capture, analysis scripts, and figure-generation scripts. X1 and X2 are marked reported_not_rerun, all method implementations are not located, and the claim map labels the quantitative evidence source_reported/cannot_verify_locally.
issues.why_it_matters: Only manuscript aggregates are available. Their arithmetic consistency does not verify item pairing, sample identity, score vectors, bootstrap intervals, Holm families, implementation fidelity, or the stated decision chronology. Every empirical headline therefore remains cannot_verify rather than independently supported.
issues.required_fix: Release a blinded, immutable bundle containing the E10-E15 item-level records, question and candidate identifiers, prompts, score vectors, predictions, correctness labels, persisted orders, exact implementations, preregistrations, environment lock, commands, analysis scripts, and a content-hashed manifest.
issues.verification_test: From a clean environment, validate all hashes and run one documented command that exactly or within declared tolerances reproduces every sample count, arm accuracy, discordance pair, interval, p-value, multiplicity decision, table, and quantitative figure; independently verify pool disjointness and schedule replay.
issues.evidence_needed: The complete objects specified in Appendix Tables 22-23, including machine-readable preregistrations and immutable raw paired records.

issues.location: p. 3 Setup, lines 120-145; p. 4 Load-bearing estimand, lines 165-175; p. 5 Table 2; pp. 7-8 Persisted-schedule sensitivity; p. 9 Limitations
issues.observed_evidence: mc_uniform uses random mask subsets, yet the snapshot reports only one record per budget and no across-seed uncertainty analysis. rand_inject is explicitly one persisted schedule whose nominal seed depended on an unpinned Python string hash. The load-bearing estimand averages over named items but does not state whether it conditions on or averages over scoring randomness, and the stored orders needed for replay are absent.
issues.why_it_matters: McNemar and item-bootstrap uncertainty for one realized RNG trace do not quantify variation over scorer seeds or random schedules. Consequently, the primary and budget-curve effects may characterize particular random realizations rather than expected protocol performance.
issues.required_fix: Define the stochastic estimand explicitly. Either narrow claims to immutable realized schedules and provide exact replay evidence, or run multiple independently pinned seeds for every stochastic operating point and estimate uncertainty over both questions and scorer randomness.
issues.verification_test: Replay each frozen seed bitwise, then run a preregistered set of independent seeds with stable RNG derivation. Verify that the paired gap distribution and its seed-aware interval remain on the claimed side of zero and the stated practical threshold.
issues.evidence_needed: Per-seed item-level outputs, stable seed derivation, persisted mask and reveal orders, and a hierarchical or otherwise seed-aware paired analysis.

issues.location: p. 3 Bed and pairing, lines 120-133; p. 4 Load-bearing estimand; p. 11 Appendix A Fresh-pool recipe; p. 20 Table 23 Sampling frames and Distractor construction
issues.observed_evidence: Question identifiers, source split membership, selection and exclusion rules, and candidate-construction records are absent. Disjointness and balance are asserted but cannot be checked. The fresh pool combines 336 near-miss items and 483 answer-pool items, while its answer positions are only approximately balanced.
issues.why_it_matters: Without the sampling frame, it is impossible to rule out outcome-informed item selection, duplicated or overlapping questions, correlated constructions, or exclusions that change the effect. The population supporting the reported inferential tests is therefore unclear even though the prose narrows conclusions to named pools.
issues.required_fix: Release the frozen sampling frame and deterministic, outcome-blind selection and distractor-generation procedures, including split membership, exclusions, deduplication, answer-position assignment, and timestamps relative to analysis decisions.
issues.verification_test: Rebuild all choice sets from source data, byte-compare them with scored inputs, verify exact pool sizes and cross-pool disjointness, audit near-duplicate questions, and reproduce paired results after prespecified stratified weighting and deduplication.
issues.evidence_needed: Question and candidate identifiers, source split metadata, selection logs, distractor builder, shuffle seeds, and overlap-audit output.

issues.location: p. 4 Registration and principal-contrast selection, lines 185-195; pp. 7-8 Endpoint decision tree and pool heterogeneity discussion; pp. 14-15 Tables 11-13; evidence/claim_evidence_map.tsv
issues.observed_evidence: Draw matching was chosen after a small-pool scan, the 2L/2L contrast is explicitly post-selected, and the fresh endpoint was elevated after observing heterogeneity. Immutable registrations are absent, so timing cannot be verified. Moreover, the claim-evidence map labels the 2L/2L statement A14-C1 as primary, whereas the manuscript consistently calls matched-L primary and 2L/2L a post-selected sensitivity.
issues.why_it_matters: Transparent disclosure reduces but does not remove selection bias. Inconsistent evidence roles and unavailable preregistrations prevent a reviewer from distinguishing confirmatory evidence from exploratory endpoint selection or determining whether all inspected comparisons entered the multiplicity accounting.
issues.required_fix: Reconcile the claim registry with the manuscript, publish immutable registrations and a complete endpoint/test ledger, retain post-selected analyses as exploratory, and use an untouched preregistered pool for any confirmatory claim about 2L matching or fresh-pool prioritization.
issues.verification_test: Audit registration hashes and timestamps against output creation times, enumerate every inspected arm-budget-pool-stratum test, reproduce the declared familywise corrections, and confirm the selected findings on an outcome-untouched pool under the frozen plan.
issues.evidence_needed: Timestamped preregistrations, full decision and test ledger, all inspected results, and a new untouched confirmatory record if confirmatory status is retained.

issues.location: p. 1 Abstract; pp. 7-8 Section 6 and Table 5; p. 11 Table 7; p. 12 Table 8
issues.observed_evidence: The fresh aggregate has fixed_inject ahead of s_conf by 5.62 points, but the near-miss stratum difference is only 2.98 points and nonsignificant, the answer-pool stratum difference is 7.45 points, and answer position 0 reverses direction by 12.56 points. The same deterministic contrast is undetermined on n=400, and the manuscript reports another sign reversal on historical n=64. The answer-position analysis is post-hoc.
issues.why_it_matters: The headline aggregate is not a stable schedule effect: it depends strongly on candidate construction and answer placement and lacks independent cross-pool confirmation. The manuscript appropriately caveats this, but the evidence cannot support broader importance beyond the exact constructed pool.
issues.required_fix: Run an untouched, preregistered factorial evaluation that independently randomizes answer position, balances distractor construction, and repeats candidate shuffles. Estimate schedule-by-position and schedule-by-construction interactions with simultaneous intervals rather than relying only on selected stratum tests.
issues.verification_test: Confirm that a prespecified standardized fixed-versus-confidence contrast retains its sign and practical magnitude across independent answer shuffles and both construction strata, and that interaction conclusions replicate on untouched questions.
issues.evidence_needed: New balanced factorial item-level outcomes with frozen shuffle seeds, interaction analysis, and independent-pool replication.

issues.location: p. 4 Registration and principal-contrast selection; p. 8 Table 5 MDE80 column; p. 18 Appendix G Power and sample-size ledger
issues.observed_evidence: The manuscript states that a planning MDE sized the n=400 pool and distinguishes it from a 4-point promotion gate, but it does not provide the planning assumptions or reproducible calculation for the primary study. Several MDE80 entries use realized discordance counts, while the absent preregistration prevents checking whether tail conventions and stopping rules were frozen.
issues.why_it_matters: Observed strong effects do not depend on post-hoc power, but readers cannot assess whether sample sizes, detectable effects, stopping, and practical thresholds were prospectively coherent or whether the 4-point gate had adequate power under the corrected alpha.
issues.required_fix: Provide the prospective power calculation with assumed discordance, direction, familywise alpha, target effect, stopping rule, and sensitivity range. Label realized-discordance MDEs as descriptive and avoid using them as evidence of adequate design power.
issues.verification_test: Reproduce each planned sample size and MDE from the preregistered inputs analytically or by simulation and verify operating characteristics under plausible paired outcome tables.
issues.evidence_needed: Preregistered power notebook or script, input assumptions, and simulation or analytic output.

ethics_concerns: No material ethics concern is identifiable from the frozen snapshot. The work uses an established benchmark and model scoring outputs without reported human-subject intervention. Dataset licensing and release conditions should be respected when publishing item-level artifacts.
llm_usage_disclosure: This review was produced by an isolated AI subagent for internal pre-submission quality control.
evidence_that_would_raise_score: A complete hash-pinned bundle that independently reproduces every central statistic, confirms pool identities and disjointness, and verifies the preregistration chronology.
A seed-aware analysis showing stable matched-L, 2L, and high-budget effects across independently pinned random-mask realizations.
An untouched preregistered replication with balanced distractor construction and randomized answer positions that confirms the deterministic fixed-order boundary.
A complete multiplicity ledger demonstrating that all inspected budgets, arms, pools, and post-hoc strata are properly classified and corrected.
Replication on additional models, datasets, or answer formats sufficient to make the protocol-audit contribution consequential beyond the single constructed bed.
evidence_that_would_lower_score: Recomputation that fails to match any reported accuracy, discordance count, interval, adjusted decision, or pool identity.
Evidence of question overlap, outcome-informed pool selection, candidate duplication, or incorrect answer-position balancing.
Independent scorer seeds that materially widen the uncertainty, reverse a principal contrast, or remove the claimed practical margin.
An untouched balanced replication in which the fixed-order result disappears or is explained entirely by answer placement or distractor construction.
Registration timestamps or a complete test ledger showing that confirmatory labels or multiplicity families were assigned after inspecting the relevant outcomes.
review_limitations: The underlying experiments, preregistrations, code, and item-level records were absent, so all experimental measurements are cannot_verify beyond aggregate arithmetic consistency.
The review was restricted to the frozen snapshot and did not inspect repository history, prior reviews, author notes, external literature, or outside artifacts.
The citation lock reports that no citations were verified this round, so citation support and novelty positioning remain cannot_verify.
The primary specialty of this review is experimental rigor; broader literature judgments are correspondingly limited.
